# cad work
so i started working on the 3d model for my project and i am using onshape as i learned how to use it in week 2.
so i found a refference image to make screen and a little back ground . after that i made entry and exits wit a place to put all the seats i have not put any seats yet but i will and close all the wall and also and make proper enterence, parking lot and everything a theater requires. i fased probelms like internet issuse on onshape but that was manageable everything went pretty smooth.

### 2026-11-03: # All the work on the project because i forgot to log

**15h**

# All the work on the project because i forgot to log
ok so i started to work right off where i left in previous log so in last log i only made the area for screen and and the base but there was a problem the are area for screen was pretty much less than required and it was supposed to be hollow but it wasn't so i changed that. after that i made  made thick walls and put a even thicker block cut it up a lot of of times to make elevation required for placing seats , took me few tries to make it properly after that i cut that thick block even more to make stairs . after that i made the back wall after that i made sketch of every sad manually and even made every seat manually by hand no copy pasting it took a lot of time and i mean a lot . you know that every theater needs a washroom don't it so i worked on washroom mad the walls and a good looking door and a 3d sign for washroom and in the washroom i made urinals and  every other thing needed idk why i made a washroom but i did and it is a little cursed i think . after making a washroom i made an entry and exit for the hall and also made an employees only area with some boxes ,barrel and a table inside btw employees only sign is 3d too . i  also made little traffic cones to keep people in line and after that i made a roof to cover it all  and after that i made a thick block again and cut it up nicely to serve as logo . it looks like a ticket. after that i xted a little portion of roof to make a hallway and also added pillars and made round pathways connect it . left pathway is exit and right is entry and i even made a parking lot wit proper markups. overall i tried to make it as much detailed as i can i even made seats smoother in the end.
i had  few problems building it but overall i think i am really happy with the results .
